children: Copper is higher in early Asian trading as some investors buy the dip. Copper prices have dropped in recent weeks, partially due to the weak sentiment around AI trades. Copper is critical to data center development. "Despite the heavy falls in AI stocks, funding for the buildout of data centres is largely in place for the next 18 months," ANZ research analysts say in a commentary. Copper should continue to benefit from the construction boom, they add. The three-month LME copper contract is 3.0% higher at $12,001.00 a ton.(tracy.qu@wsj.com)
